channel.description: Latest articles from Nursing in Practice (nursinginpractice.com)

item.title: SAPHNA continues its partnership with Nursing in Practice events
item.description: Nursing in Practice has partnered with the School and Public Health Nurses Association for our series of exclusive events for a second year.

item.title: NMC affirms advanced practice nursing is ‘not a doctor substitute’
item.description: Advanced nurse practitioners are ‘not a substitute for medical practitioners’ but a ‘welcome and vital role’, the nursing regulator has said.

item.title: Stricter rules on high-risk cosmetic procedures to be enforced in Scotland
item.description: A new Bill introducing stricter regulations of higher-risk cosmetic procedures has been approved by politicians in Scotland.

item.title: ‘GPNs support people through the most vulnerable, meaningful moments of their lives’
item.description: Lead practice nurse, Natalie Holdaway, wants to advocate for more student nurses to learn about general practice.

item.title: New executive director of RCN Wales appointed
item.description: A new executive director of the Royal College of Nursing (RCN) Wales has been appointed - Nicola Williams replaces Helen Whyley.

item.title: Register Login Page
item.description: GP practice teams in England will be expected to meet a target of seeing 90% of clinically urgent patients on the same day by March 2027, the Department of Health and Social Care (DHSC) has said. The goal has been confirmed under measures to improve access to general practice that form part of the wider... Read more The post Same-day access target set out for general practice teams appeared first on Nursing in Practice.

item.title: ‘Limited access’ to specialist dementia nurses at end of life, report finds
item.description: A dementia charity has called for expanded access to specialist dementia nurses after a survey revealed people are left without support

item.title: Register Login Page

item.title: Fitness to practise dashboard launched by NMC to highlight midwifery cases
item.description: The nursing regulator has launched a new interactive dashboard to provide data about midwifery fitness to practise (FtP) cases.

item.title: MenB vaccination offer expanded to include some year 11 pupils in Kent
item.description: Meningitis vaccinations will be offered to Year 11 students across four Kent schools, the UK Health and Security Agency (UKHSA) has said.
